LESSON: KINGS DAVID AND SOLOMON

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible: Selected Teachings
Topic 2.3: Kings David and Solomon

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Kings David and Solomon. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how King Solomon, 1. Why did King Solomon fail in his leadership?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ
2. outline qualities of a good leader from leadership
3. assess the achievements and failures of King

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ
   In simple words: practise until you can analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. outline qualities of a good leader from leadership
   In simple words: practise until you can outline qualities of a good leader from leadership. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. assess the achievements and failures of King
   In simple words: practise until you can assess the achievements and failures of King. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Kings David and Solomon using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Kings David and Solomon in the examples.
2. Explain Kings David and Solomon to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kings David and Solomon.
4. Show that you can: analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Kings David and Solomon using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kings David and Solomon important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Jointly list names of members in their family tree,
2. Team up to read and discuss 2 Samuel 7:12-16, Matthew 1:1-2 , Luke 1: 32-33 and make summary notes on; David an ancestor of Jesus Christ,
3. In turns read 1 Samuel 16:1-23, 2 Samuel 6:1-15 and write key points on the importance of David as a King in Israel,
4. Discuss and make notes on the characteristics of a good leader,
5. Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is exhibited as learners conduct a discussion and make notes on characteristics of a good leader.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how King Solomon, 1. Why did King Solomon fail in his leadership?
2. Why was King David a man after God’s own heart?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ
2. outline qualities of a good leader from leadership
3. assess the achievements and failures of King

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
